tools.name: book_discovery_call
tools.description: Book a real 30-minute Cuvo discovery call for the user. Requires their explicit confirmation of a specific slot from get_availability plus their real full name and email; the calendar invite goes to that email. Do not book without the user's consent.

slot_start_iso.description: startIso of the chosen slot, exactly as returned by get_availability

timezone.description: IANA timezone used when fetching availability

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Full text (markdown) of one published article, by slug from list_articles.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Next open 30-minute discovery-call slots on the Cuvo team's calendar, in the user's timezone. Call before offering any times; returns each slot's startIso and human label.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the user, e.g. "America/New_York". Defaults to America/New_York.

tools.name: get_comparison
tools.description: Full text (markdown) of one Cuvo-vs-competitor comparison page, by slug from list_comparisons.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: What Cuvo Health is, who it is for, and the canonical FAQ: the white label telehealth platform that operates the licensed clinic behind consumer brands.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Cuvo's published pricing as markdown: plan tiers with setup fees, the flat $25 per-consult fee, 0% medication markup, commercial terms, and add-ons.

tools.name: inspect_image_c2pa
tools.description: Fetch a single image (by CSS selector or URL) and return its fully decoded C2PA manifest store: every manifest's claim, assertions (e.g. c2pa.actions edit history, schema.org authorship), and the COSE signature details (algorithm and signing-certificate identity). Provide exactly one of `selector` or `url`. Note: the signature is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

selector.description: CSS selector for an element on the page.

url.description: Image URL (absolute, or relative to the current page) to fetch and inspect.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: List every published article on the Cuvo blog (slug, title, excerpt, date, category): telehealth compliance, pharmacy, and growth guides.

tools.name: list_comparisons
tools.description: List every Cuvo-vs-competitor comparison page (slug, competitor name, one-line summary, facts-reviewed date).

tools.name: request_callback
tools.description: Ask the Cuvo team to phone the user back, when live booking is unavailable or the user prefers a callback. Requires the user's consent, name, and phone number.

tools.name: scan_images_c2pa
tools.description: Scan every on the current page for C2PA Content Credentials (content provenance metadata) and return a per-image summary: whether a manifest is present, the claim generator (the tool that produced or edited the image), the title, and the signer name. Use this to find which images on a page carry provenance data. Note: provenance is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

limit.description: Maximum number of images to fetch and scan (default 25, max 100).
